title: Add Support for Image Inputs with Perplexity Provider
body:
### Description

Perplexity AI now supports image inputs https://docs.perplexity.ai/guides/image-guid. It would be helpful if vercel/ai could add support for sending images to the Perplexity provider, enabling multimodal queries. This would keep the integration up to date and allow users to use Perplexity’s new image features.

linked_prs.title: feat(provider/perplexity): support image input

## Background

<!-- Why was this change necessary? -->

While Perplexity's core API (excluding `sonar-deep-research`) allows image input as documented here: [https://docs.perplexity.ai/guides/image-guide](https://docs.perplexity.ai/guides/image-guide), this functionality is not yet available in the `@ai-sdk/perplexity` package.

## Summary

<!-- What did you change? -->
I change function `convertToPerplexityMessages` to support image as input. I also create new type for message content: `PerplexityMessageContent`
